📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Reworked CIM persistence: removed the monolithic `onEnableCIM` flow and split it into exported operations (`patchProvisioning`, `createAgentServiceConfig`, `editAgentServiceConfig`, `configureIngressLoadBalancer`, `isIngressController`). Annotation patching for AgentServiceConfig is now conditional. Errors are thrown (with `getErrorMessage`) instead of `setError` control flow. Ingress domain is derived by listing routes. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**CIM persistence logic**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/modals/CimConfiguration/persist.ts`|Removed `onEnableCIM`; added/changed exported functions: `patchProvisioning`, `createAgentServiceConfig(values)`, `editAgentServiceConfig(...)`, `configureIngressLoadBalancer({ t })`, and `isIngressController()`. Switched to thrown Errors with `getErrorMessage`. Conditional JSON Patch construction for `/metadata/annotations` (add full annotations object, remove annotation key, or append targeted patch). Removed localStorage write and platform-specific LB branching from persist logic; ingress domain now derived by listing routes and errors are thrown on failures.| |**Modal save flow / UI**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/modals/CimConfiguration/CimConfigurationModal.tsx`|Replaced single `onEnableCIM` usage with sequential calls to `patchProvisioning` (conditional), `editAgentServiceConfig` or `createAgentServiceConfig`, localStorage timestamp write, and optional `configureIngressLoadBalancer`. Introduced segmented error handling, uses `getErrorMessage` for alerts, and updated imports.| |**Localization**
`libs/locales/lib/en/translation.json`|Removed translation key `"ai:Can not query routes.": "Cannot query routes."`.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant UI as Client (Modal) participant Persist as Persist Module participant K8s as Kubernetes API participant Routes as Routes Listing participant IC as IngressController UI->>Persist: save (values, editMode?) Persist->>K8s: patchProvisioning (if needed) Persist->>K8s: create/edit AgentServiceConfig (conditional patches to metadata/annotations) Persist->>Routes: list routes (derive domain for ingress/LB) Routes-->>Persist: routes (or error) Persist->>K8s: ensure IngressController exists / patch route host & labels K8s-->>Persist: patch/list responses Persist-->>UI: throw success/error (uses getErrorMessage) ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Suggested reviewers - LiorSoffer - ammont82 - rawagner ## Poem > 🐰 I hopped through patches, slices, and strings, > I split the big function into smaller wings, > I set annotations with careful care, > I list routes for the domain up there, > Bravo — nibble, deploy, and spring! 🥕✨

The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. |

`365-383`: **Skip no-op annotation patches to avoid unnecessary resource writes.** This branch still patches when there is no effective change (e.g., missing annotations + `ciscoIntersightURL` undefined, or existing annotations + empty `patches`). Guarding both cases avoids needless API calls and metadata churn.
Proposed change ```diff - if (!agentServiceConfig.metadata?.annotations) { + if (!agentServiceConfig.metadata?.annotations && ciscoIntersightURL !== undefined) { await k8sPatch({ model: AgentServiceConfigModel, resource: agentServiceConfig, data: [ { op: 'add', path: '/metadata/annotations', value: { ciscoIntersightURL }, }, ], }); - } else { + } else if (patches.length > 0) { await k8sPatch({ model: AgentServiceConfigModel, resource: agentServiceConfig, data: patches, }); } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. returns early when isIngressController() is true, preventing

configureIngressLoadBalancer calls isIngressController() and only skips
createIngressController() when true but always proceeds to call
getAssistedImageServiceRoute, getClusterDomain and
patchAssistedImageServiceRoute so the route is patched even if the controller
already exists. In practice, call isIngressController() once, if false await
createIngressController(t, domain) (after computing domain), but do not return
early — always await patchAssistedImageServiceRoute(t,
assistedImageServiceRoute, domain); keep using the existing helpers
createIngressController, patchAssistedImageServiceRoute,
getAssistedImageServiceRoute and getClusterDomain.

assuming ASSISTED_IMAGE_SERVICE_ROUTE_PREFIX appears; validate that
assistedImageServiceRoute.spec?.host actually contains the prefix (e.g.,
host.indexOf(prefix) !== -1 or host.includes(prefix)) before computing
appsDomain and domain, and throw a clear error via t(...) if the prefix is
missing or the subsequent '.' boundaries are not found; update getClusterDomain
to perform these checks using ASSISTED_IMAGE_SERVICE_ROUTE_PREFIX and fail fast
instead of producing a garbage domain.
